endpoints.summary: Drive to a saved place or a map point along a planned route around furniture, then face the place's target (or yaw_deg). Re-plans up to 3 times around obstacles not on the map. Narrow ('squeeze') routes: drives to 1.0 m before the narrow part, then re-plans with the live lidar. Under tops (since 10-25): for a live cell whose top is [0.18, 0.6] .. 1.0 m (desk, table, chair back), anything at bump height under it (chair seat, legs, drawers) is a live obstacle that the fallback tiers never relax; open floor under a top costs UNDER_COST (3.0) extra per 10 cm cell, and so does the saved map's solid desk-top layer anywhere (MID_COST 3.0, fill >= 0.6), grown by 0.15 m. So routes pass under desks only when every other way is much longer. A cost, not a block: blocking desk tops closed every route to marker B on 10-23. Stops with stop_reason lost if loc.lost comes on (true). Close enough within 0.2 m. Preview the route first with GET /nav/plan.

stop_reasons.arrived: move, turn or go_to finished. Carry on.
stop_reasons.obstacle: blocked by something in the obstacle box (move) or not on the map (go_to). Look (photo), then go around: turn and move, or go_to again (it plans around it for 120.0 s).
stop_reasons.stuck: no progress for 2.0 s after one re-plant step: avoidance stopped the dog, or a foot or leg is caught. Photo first; back up a little (slowly) or turn, then retry. Twice in a row: ask a person.
stop_reasons.no_route: the planner found no route. Work down notes.when_go_to_fails in order: localization first, then why.cause / why.blocks / fallback, then a photo (chairs are seen live since 10-25), only then the pose or map.
stop_reasons.timeout: timeout_s ran out mid-way. The dog stopped where it was; give go_to a longer timeout_s.
stop_reasons.stop: an agent's /agent/stop or someone pressed STOP. Don't resume blindly: check status first.
stop_reasons.person: a person took over. Your claim is gone until they hand back (or 300.0 s without console commands). Wait; poll status every 10-30 s.
stop_reasons.lost: go_to stopped because loc.lost is on: the map pose is probably wrong. relocalize (search, then global), set the best candidate if its fit is clearly best, then go_to again.
stop_reasons.not_standing: the dog is lying down: posture {pose: stand}, then retry.
stop_reasons.fallen: roll or pitch over 0.6 rad. Stop everything and ask a person.
stop_reasons.stale_sensors: odometry or IMU older than 1.0 s: the driver or the dog is off. Don't drive; tell a person.
stop_reasons.refused: 409: a person has taken over or another agent has control (claim or any call that needs a claim): wait, poll status. Or relocalize set: the pose fits worse than the current one (send force only if you are sure).
stop_reasons.busy: 409: another tool is still running (often your own previous call after a client timeout). Wait, or stop.
stop_reasons.bad_arguments: 400: missing or wrong arguments; nothing ran and nothing was logged. Fix the call.
stop_reasons.error: anything else: read reason (bad place id, no_map_pose, no_camera_frame, posture timeout, ...).

notes.frames: odom: the dog's own frame, restarts at every reboot, drifts in heading standing still (median +1.2 deg/min, -4 to +6 per period; pose logs 10-23..25). map: the saved lab map; map = R(th) * odom + t with T = (tx, ty, th) from line-up and drift tracking. Places, go_to, /nav/plan, /trail and relocalize are in map metres. yaw fields are radians (CCW from +x, in [-pi, pi)); *_deg fields are degrees. move/turn work on odometry only.
notes.signs: turn deg + = left (CCW). look deg + = up. move m + = forward. /markers bearing_deg + = right (atan2(x, z), camera x to the right). /trail/near bearing_deg + = left (map angle to the spot minus the frame's yaw). map yaw + = CCW.
notes.ownership: One agent owns the dog at a time. claim, or any tool call, takes and refreshes it; it lapses after 60.0 s without a call. status, stop, release and say need no claim. A person always wins: driving at the console, Take over, or a console STOP aborts the running tool (stop_reason person or stop) and locks agents out (409 refused) until Hand back or 300.0 s without console commands. /agent/stop is allowed for anyone and does not change the owner. One tool at a time: a second call while one runs gets 409 {result: error, reason: 'busy: ...', stop_reason: busy}.
notes.safety: Before any motion tool and every 0.1 s during it: odom and IMU fresher than 1.0 s, |roll| and |pitch| under 0.6 rad, body_height at least 0.18 m. Obstacle box ahead [0.35, 0.9, 0.25] (x from, x to, half width, m) when avoidance is off; behind [0.3, 0.75, 0.22], always checked; heights [0.18, 0.6] m count. Backing up is slow (0.2 m/s) and short (1.0 m) because the dog sees little behind it.
notes.localization: loc.track_fit: how well the latest lidar view sits on the map's walls, about 0.75-0.9 when placed right. The tracker matches only lidar voxels first seen in the last 20.0 s (falls back to all when fewer than 200 fresh obstacle points): /point_cloud2 is the dog's accumulated voxel map, and old voxels carry old heading drift. So track_fit can dip after a long time standing still without the pose being wrong. loc.lost turns on when track_fit stays under 0.65 for 10.0 s while the dog walks at least 0.3 m; it clears at 0.7 or on a new placement or line-up. loc.fit, runner_up and unsure describe the last line-up only (unsure: score under 0.3 or less than 0.05 ahead of the next heading). Event kinds: hand_placement, auto_align, session_restore, new_map, drift_correction (only jumps > 0.3 m or 10 deg), agent_relocalize, unknown (POST /map frame). loc.suspect / fresh_fit / suspect_since are ADVISORY and never stop anything: fresh_fit is the fit of the voxels placed in the last 10.0 s at the current pose; suspect comes on when it stays under 0.65 for 10.0 s while the dog walks 0.3 m, and clears at 0.7 or a placement. It can't tell a wrong pose from a changed room: on suspect take a fix_ok marker or a relocalize search before a long go_to. In /state.json loc and (suspect) in every tool reply; not in /history. The lost and suspect timers restart after a gap > 5.0 s between judged views.
notes.localization_notice: Agent replies (and GET /agent/status?client=) carry localization_notice when line-up events happened since your previous call: {events, status, fit, runner_up, unsure, summary}. A jump means poses you stored before it may be off.
when_go_to_fails: for no_route, obstacle or stuck, check in order and stop at the first that explains it:
1. localization: lost and suspect (tool reply), loc.fresh_fit / loc.track_fit; if bad, the route came from a wrong pose: relocalize first and trust nothing else in the reply.
2. planner state: why.cause, why.blocks and fallback; 'live lidar or temporary blocks' with saved_map_has_route true = stall blocks (120.0 s) or live cells closed it, not the map.

3. a photo: chairs, people, bags. Chairs are seen live since 10-25, so no_route in a desk aisle may be correct. GET /nav/grid?json=1 gives the narrowest clearance on the last route and what is around it.
4. only then a pose or map problem: relocalize search, /nav/plan, ask a person.

start pocket (e.g. door_outside): the only exit is under 0.2 m within 1.5 m of the dog; why.saved_map_has_route false, it just drove in, /nav/grid clear_here_m < 0.2. It may leave the way it came within 300.0 s; otherwise photo, then move or turn out a little and retry.
stall blocks: why.blocks > 0 after a stuck/obstacle nearby in the last 120.0 s, and the saved map has a route; the live_noblocks fallback retries without them, or wait.
lost: lost or suspect on, low fresh_fit; routes and blocks may sit in the wrong place. Relocalize.
failure_signatures: centring a marker: turn(-bearing_deg) (marker bearing + = right, turn + = left).
stale_sensors with odom null in /state.json: the dog or the driver container is off.
photo.still false: it never settled in 5 s (rocking, still turning); take another.
turned_deg short of deg with result done: within the 5 degree tolerance after one correction.
a marker in /markers with held: true is a sighting up to 0.5 s old, not a live one; use fix_ok items for positions (a single-frame sighting is unconfirmed).

an expected marker missing: markers read reliably from the open room, not from under or next to dark furniture (auto-exposure blows out the bright room; patches brighter than ~230/255 are mostly missed). Back out into the open or turn so the camera isn't looking from dark into bright.
notes.http: Base http://172.17.40.64:8080. POST bodies are JSON. POSTs only from localhost or 172.17.0.0/18 (403 otherwise). An unknown /agent/<call> is 404. Bad arguments to a tool (missing m, non-number, bad pose or mode) are 400 {result: error, reason: 'bad arguments: ...', stop_reason: bad_arguments}, and are not logged.
